categories.main_business_segments: Nextool Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: semiconductor packaging equipment and molds, and plastic extrusion molding molds, extrusion molding devices, and downstream equipment. The company focuses on intelligent manufacturing equipment for semiconductor back-end plastic packaging processes and plastic extrusion molding processes, providing customized equipment and system solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies including Weissenberg-Robinowitsch corrected PowerLaw non-Newtonian fluid models, multi-chamber high-speed extrusion molding, co-extrusion molding, dynamic PID pressure control, real-time injection pressure curve monitoring, and high-temperature synchronous deformation adjustment mechanisms. It also possesses proprietary technologies in semiconductor resin handling, automatic packaging equipment, and precision mold manufacturing, supported by numerous patents and software copyrights.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic semiconductor packaging companies such as Tongfu Microelectronics, Huatian Technology, and Changdian Technology. The plastic extrusion molding equipment serves global plastic window and door profile manufacturers, with products exported to over 40 countries, mainly in Europe and North America. The company targets semiconductor back-end packaging and plastic extrusion molding industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and manufacturing base in Tongling, Anhui Province. Its plastic extrusion molding products have a strong international presence, exporting to more than 40 countries and regions, especially in Europe and North America. Semiconductor packaging equipment sales are mainly domestic.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nextool operates mainly in the midstream of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sale of intelligent manufacturing equipment and molds used by downstream semiconductor packaging and plastic extrusion molding manufacturers. It procures raw materials and components from upstream suppliers and delivers customized equipment to downstream customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation and R&D investment, focusing on advancing semiconductor packaging equipment towards wafer-level and panel-level advanced packaging to achieve domestic substitution of imports. It also aims to enhance intelligent, energy-efficient, and high-output plastic extrusion molding equipment. R&D efforts include developing new products, improving manufacturing processes, and expanding patent portfolios.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized intelligent manufacturing equipment and molds to semiconductor packaging and plastic extrusion molding enterprises. The company uses a direct sales model, with contracts signed directly with customers, and revenue recognized upon delivery, installation, and acceptance of products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In semiconductor packaging equipment, the company competes with international giants like TOWA, YAMADA, ASM Pacific, BESI, and DISCO, holding a position among the few domestic suppliers with growing competitiveness. In plastic extrusion molding equipment, it is a leading domestic player with significant export scale, competing with international brands such as Austria's EXELLIQ. The company is recognized as a leading domestic brand in both segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 198 million, a 26.39% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to semiconductor industry downturns. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 52.4 million, down 8.36%. Despite the downturn, plastic extrusion molding business grew steadily, with exports increasing by 38.29%. Total assets reached RMB 1.14 billion, with net assets of RMB 970.8 million, showing modest growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nextool emphasizes its unique design philosophy, proprietary process technologies, high product quality, rich debugging experience, and comprehensive after-sales service. Its semiconductor packaging equipment narrows the gap with international top brands and aims for domestic self-reliance and global competitiveness. Its plastic extrusion molding equipment offers advanced core technologies and high precision, serving high-end markets with strong international brand recognition.
